name: Dual Null Space Disguise
description: Transforms the linear span condition into its orthogonal complement (null space) equivalent. Instead of requiring target difference vectors to be in the span of the selected vectors, it requires that any vector orthogonal to the selected vectors has equal coordinates at the target dimensions. This forces the model to deduce the equivalence to graph connectivity from first principles of linear algebra, breaking surface-level associations with paths and spanning trees.
